description: This file defines a PHP interface named OutpostsArnInterface within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically in the Arn/S3 namespace. It extends another interface called ArnInterface and declares a method getOutpostId, indicating it is used for representing or handling AWS S3 Outposts ARNs.

classes.name: OutpostsArnInterface
classes.description: An interface for AWS S3 Outposts ARNs, extending the general ARN interface and adding a method to retrieve the Outpost ID.

methods.name: getOutpostId
methods.description: Method to retrieve the Outpost ID associated with the ARN.
